organization.about: University of Sheffield is a public research university in Sheffield, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across engineering, science, medicine, business, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community connects research and teaching with practical challenges in health, technology, sustainability and society.

intro: This Sheffield ECOSOLUTIONS doctorate investigates how behavioural interventions can reduce pollution from residents’ domestic activities. It combines evidence synthesis with experimental evaluation.
description:
Research Summary

This Sheffield ECOSOLUTIONS doctorate investigates how behavioural interventions can reduce pollution from residents’ domestic activities.

It combines evidence synthesis with experimental evaluation.

Official Project Title

Leveraging behavioural change to reduce urban pollution

Research Focus and Methods

Review and meta-analyse existing interventions, pilot promising approaches using surveys and focus groups, then test selected interventions in real settings with behavioural or pollution-related measures.

Research Training and Development

Includes a three-month secondment with JNCC.

How to Apply

  1. Read the official ECOSOLUTIONS programme page and the linked project advert.
  2. Use the Apply now link on the official programme page and identify the relevant project.
  3. Follow the application form’s current supporting-document instructions; the programme page does not provide a complete document checklist.
  4. Contact the project supervisor for project-specific questions.

Applications are assessed by the programme committee; shortlisted candidates are invited to online interviews. The interview date is not yet specified.
